mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of high housing starts.
